verdict.rationale: Supabase docs describe branch-and-merge workflows (branching creates isolated preview environments per PR, CLI-based migration files under version control) as the intended safe path for schema changes [supabase-docs-25][supabase-docs-26][supabase-docs-36]. However, hands-on community reports directly contradict the safety/maturity of this workflow: users call local dev/migrations 'Supabase's biggest weakness,' report having to run migrations live in prod, and even Supabase's own CEO publicly discourages dashboard-driven prod edits and admits Preview Databases (to enforce migration-only changes) were still being built [supabase-comm-5][supabase-comm-6][supabase-comm-7]. This is a concrete documented gap between the vendor's branch/merge story and real-world practice, not mere skepticism. Missing for 10: independent verification that branching/merge requests reliably prevent locking or breaking prod today, and confirmation that Preview Databases enforcement has shipped.
